title: The certified local-business directory, and how much of it the City files can see
question: What does the City's directory of certified local businesses hold, and how many of its firms appear in the contract and payment files?
finding: The directory export lists 973 certified firms: 904 LBE, 53 PLBE, 16 NLBE. 295 are in District 10. 166 carry participation-credit restrictions naming 229 affiliated firms. By name, 662 directory firms appear on a team in the Controller's contract file and 444 were paid directly by the City since fiscal 2019 ($3.46 billion in all). No City file on disk carries the directory's supplier numbers, so every join is by name.
how: Counts from the directory export as saved. Firms are matched to the contract file (every prime contractor, joint-venture member and subcontractor) and to the payment file on the project's normalised name key, also comparing the first 30 characters because the contract file cuts names there, and both sides of a "DBA".
limits: The export is the current directory: a firm whose certification lapsed or was withdrawn is not in it, so the counts say nothing about past contracts. Subcontractors are paid by the prime contractor, not by the City, so a certified subcontractor missing from the payment file is expected. A name match can miss a firm that the files spell differently.
